c-member-space-pagination.1.evidence: No 'jt-qa-paging' space; created temp QA-RFT Paging with per-space posts_per_page=3 and 8 topics (deleted afterwards): bob sees exactly 3 topics and a Load More link.

c-member-space-pagination.2.evidence: One click on Load More adds 3 more (6 total), no duplicate links.

c-member-space-pagination.3.evidence: Scrolling to the bottom with the wheel does not load anything (3 stay).

c-member-space-pagination.4.evidence: Third click reaches 8 topics and the Load More link disappears.

c-member-space-pagination.5.evidence: Feature Requests has 13 topics on this seed (no 30+ topic space); not walkable at 30 per page.

c-member-space-pagination.6.evidence: GET /spaces/145/posts?per_page=3&offset=3 returns the next 3 ids, offset=99 returns an empty list, ?page=2 returns the same slice as offset=3 (X-WP-Total 8).

c-member-space-pagination.7.evidence: Spaces with fewer posts than one page (e.g. General Discussion 17 of 20, Amsterdam Chapter 0) show no Load More.

c-member-space-pagination.8.evidence: Topic 9 added while page 1 was open: Load More appended 5, 4 (offset shifted, one repeat skipped client-side); no duplicate row and no gap among the original topics.

c-member-space-pagination.9.evidence: Offline Load More: link stays, 'Could not load more' shown; after reconnect the retry works and the list completes.

c-member-space-pagination.10.evidence: The per-space posts_per_page setting (3) drives the first batch size. The global Settings value was not changed.

c-member-space-pagination.11.evidence: Guest on Partner Program: login prompt, no topics, no Load More.

c-member-space-pagination.12.evidence: At 390 the Load More link is 328px wide inside the 390 viewport (full container width). Dark-mode pairing and keyboard focus movement not separately checked.

c-member-space-pagination.13.evidence: Same as .8: Load More after a new topic shows no duplicate row.

c-member-space-pagination.14.evidence: Offline Load More shows the error 'Could not load more' and keeps the button.

c-member-space-pagination.15.evidence: ?page=2&per_page=1 returns the second slice: /spaces -> id 1 (page 1 gave 35), /posts/83/replies -> 411 vs 415. /subscriptions and /bookmarks page 2 return an empty list because bob has only 1 and 0 rows.
